spec: Implement add(a, b) returning the sum of two integers.

requirements.text: Implement add(a, b) returning the sum of two integers.
requirements.measurable_criteria: add(a, b) returns a + b for integer inputs.

tests.description: Addition with positive, negative and zero integers.

good_code:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
bad_code:
def add(a, b):
    return a - b
